categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Madduma Kankanamalage Bandula Harischandra, the Governor of the Southern Province) AND detailed delegation of powers and responsibilities regarding co-operative societies legislation. It specifies the exact statutory powers being delegated under specific sections of the Co-operative Societies Statute, making it a Hybrid gazette that includes both government personnel and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
